t: What Does The Name Metje Mean?
s: The diminutive ending -je is characteristically Dutch, making Metje akin to “little Mech(t)-/Mat-.” Closely related forms include Mettje, Metje (Frisian/Dutch spelling), and the Low German Mätje; parallel names in other languages are Mechthild/Mechtilde (German), Matilda/Mathilda (English), Mathilde (French), Mafalda (Portuguese/Italian, via medieval adaptation), and Mechteld/Matilde (Dutch).
